value_or_angle: header="His last plea: guard the Green" body="Henry closed his Chronicles with the Green sleeping under its old trees while compact blocks and electric cars filled in around it. Too crowded now for public buildings, he wrote, it was priceless as a place for the people to breathe, rest and gather, and must be guarded from encroachment." category=legacy
